title_sq: Tek Liqeni I Thate, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Me Planimetri, Orientim Perfekt Dhe Dy Poste Parkimi !

title_en: Near Lake I Thate, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with layout, perfect orientation and two parking spaces!
description_en: Super apartment 3+1+2, with perfect floor plan for sale near Lake Dry!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 6-story building with an elevator and is well managed and has a total area of ​​155 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchen area and exit to the balcony, 3 bedrooms, one of which has a dedicated toilet, a central toilet and 2 balconies. The orientation of the apartment is from the south-east, which means that there is natural light and sun throughout the day. It is invested and furnished in a comfortable and contemporary way. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for living, since it is located near two lakes. The clean air and tranquility in the area make it one of the most sought after for a comfortable and peaceful life. Two parking spaces are included in the price. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
